items.new_text: También puedes cargar los paquetes instalados con `library()` de **base** R.
items.problem: The restored attribution uses English word order, "de **base** R". This is the shared "Cargar paquetes" boilerplate that appears near-verbatim in about twenty Spanish chapters, and every other occurrence in the corpus writes "de R **base**" (grep over chapters/*.es.qmd: 34 files use "de R **base**", and "de **base** R" occurs exactly once, in this hunk). Two other hunks in this same batch (interactive_plots.es#3, factors.es#4) correctly used "de R **base**", so the batch is internally inconsistent.
